blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has declared Monday, Nov. 16, a special non-working day in Occidental Mindoro to allow residents to celebrate the province’s 76th founding anniversary. Proclamation No. 1512, signed by Acting Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, was issued following a request from Gov. Eduardo Gadiano. The provincial government will mark the anniversary at the Provincial Capitol Complex in Mamburao under the theme “Nagkakaisang Bayan Tungo sa Maunlad na Lalawigan” (United Communities Toward a Progressive Province).
